beats.event: Pandavas born of divine boons to Kunti and Madri; Pandu soon dies
Kauravas plot; lacquer house built of lac and ghee to burn them alive
Escape by tunnel; hide as brahmins; Bhima weds Hidimbi
Arjuna strings the great bow and wins Draupadi at her swayamvara
By Kunti's command all five brothers wed Draupadi
Kingdom split; Pandavas given a wild forest ruled by snakes
Build Indraprastha; Yudhishthira's Rajasuya crowns him foremost of kings
Shakuni's loaded dice: Yudhishthira loses wealth, brothers, self, Draupadi
Draupadi dragged into court; disrobing halted only by Krishna
Sentenced to twelve years' exile plus a thirteenth in hiding
Serve in disguise at King Virata's court through the hidden year
Peace talks fail; armies muster on the field of Kurukshetra
Bhishma falls on day ten as Shikhandi shields Arjuna's arrows
Drona lays down arms at false news of Ashwatthama's death and is beheaded
Karna's chariot wheel sinks in mud; Arjuna decapitates him
Bhima fells Duryodhana with an illegal blow; Kaurava army destroyed
Ashwatthama's night raid slaughters Pandava sons and remaining allies
Yudhishthira crowned king; performs the Ashvamedha horse sacrifice
Krishna dies; the Yadava clan destroys itself in drunken infighting
Brothers fall one by one on the Himalayan march; Yudhishthira ascends alone
